system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids

This Droid Accessory enables a Droid with a Shield Generator installed to expand its own shield by a single square, allowing an adjacent Medium or smaller ally to benefit from the Droid's SR. Activating the Shield Expansion Module is a Standard Action, and the Droid chooses the single adjacent affected square; any creature in that square uses the Droid's SR as long as it remains in that square and the Droid remains adjacent to that square. Only Droids of Small or larger size can use this Droid Accessory. Droids of Medium or smaller size can install only one Shield Expansion Module. Droids of Large or larger size can install up to two Shield Expansion Modules. A second Shield Expansion Module protects an additional square.
system.source: Star Wars Saga Edition Scavenger's Guide to Droids
system.cost: 50 x Shield Rating x Cost Factor
system.weight: (2 x Shield Rating x Cost Factor) Kilograms
